The following events took place in '''5,500 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]]'''.

==Events==
*[[Tapani sector/Legends|Tapani sector]] merchants develop the first leg of what will become the [[Rimma Trade Route/Legends|Rimma Trade Route]].
*[[Sullust/Legends|Sullust]] joins the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] when [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] merchants connect their planet to the [[Tapani sector/Legends|Tapani sector]] with the [[Rimma Trade Route/Legends|Rimma Trade Route]].
*[[Taris/Legends|Taris]] is first settled by a [[Human/Legends|Human]] fleet.
